features.statement: Layout relies on CSS grid and flexbox, with card grids and inline flex rows.
Heading hierarchy is orderly, running H1→H2→H3→H4, with a descriptive H2 section title before groups.
Uses a <main> landmark and lean, minimal markup with few divs, classes, scripts and no external stylesheets.
Typography uses the system-ui font stack rather than a webfont.
Body text is near-black navy rather than mid-gray.
Accent color is orange-red, used on CTAs, links, badges and underline bars.
Dark navy bands anchor the top bar, hero, mission block and tall footer, with pale-blue link text.
Cards, inputs and buttons have rounded corners, roughly 8px or more, including pill-shaped badges and buttons.
Hero has a gradient navy background with a large bold white headline, subtitle and dual CTAs, one filled and one outlined.
Feature cards are image-free, using numbered badges and an arrow-suffixed text link at the bottom.
Location items are white rounded bordered cards containing image and text on a gray background, with bold navy names.
Navigation sits inline beside the logo on white, with a highlighted pill for the current page, and utility links in a thin top bar.
Location search is a dedicated bar below the hero, with a select and an orange Search button.
Newsletter signup is a standalone white section with an H2, a rounded input and an orange pill button.
Footer holds multi-column link lists, a logo, a divider and a bottom legal row.
Images carry descriptive alt text for logo and hero, with decorative thumbnails given empty alt.
Page title is short and brand-only.
